definition: Improper Input Validation: The product receives input or data, but it does not validate or incorrectly validates that the input has the properties that are required to process the data safely and correctly.
scope: All users and entities interacting with the product.
policy_description: The product must validate all input data to ensure it meets the required properties for safe processing.

definition: Path Traversal: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that is intended to identify a file or directory that is located underneath a restricted parent directory.
scope: All users and entities accessing file systems through the product.
policy_description: The product must properly neutralize special elements within the pathname to prevent path traversal vulnerabilities.
reference: CWE-ID: 22 | Name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

definition: Command Injection: The product constructs all or part of a command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component.
scope: All users and entities that can influence command execution.
policy_description: The product must neutralize special elements in commands to prevent command injection vulnerabilities.
reference: CWE-ID: 77 | Name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')

definition: OS Command Injection: The product constructs all or part of an OS command using externally-influenced input.
scope: All users and entities that can influence OS command execution.
policy_description: The product must neutralize special elements in OS commands to prevent OS command injection vulnerabilities.
reference: CWE-ID: 78 | Name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

definition: Cross-site Scripting (XSS): The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page.
scope: All users and entities interacting with web pages generated by the product.
policy_description: The product must properly neutralize user input before including it in web page outputs to prevent XSS vulnerabilities.
reference: CWE-ID: 79 | Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

definition: SQL Injection: The product constructs all or part of an SQL command using externally-influenced input.
scope: All users and entities that can influence SQL command execution.
policy_description: The product must neutralize special elements in SQL commands to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities.
reference: CWE-ID: 89 | Name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

definition: Code Injection: The product constructs all or part of a code segment using externally-influenced input.
scope: All users and entities that can influence code execution.
policy_description: The product must neutralize special elements in code segments to prevent code injection vulnerabilities.
reference: CWE-ID: 94 | Name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

definition: Buffer Overflow: The product copies an input buffer to an output buffer without verifying that the size of the input buffer is less than the size of the output buffer.
scope: All users and entities interacting with memory management functions.
policy_description: The product must verify buffer sizes before copying to prevent buffer overflow vulnerabilities.
reference: CWE-ID: 120 | Name: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow')

definition: Out-of-bounds Write: The product writes data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer.
scope: All users and entities interacting with memory management functions.
policy_description: The product must ensure that all write operations respect buffer boundaries to prevent out-of-bounds write vulnerabilities.

definition: Use After Free: The product reuses or references memory after it has been freed.
scope: All users and entities interacting with memory management functions.
policy_description: The product must not reference or reuse memory after it has been freed to prevent use-after-free vulnerabilities.

definition: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF): The web server receives a URL or similar request from an upstream component and retrieves the contents of this URL.
scope: All users and entities that can influence URL requests.
policy_description: The product must validate that requests are sent to expected destinations to prevent SSRF vulnerabilities.

definition: Deserialization of Untrusted Data: The product deserializes untrusted data without sufficiently ensuring that the resulting data will be valid.
scope: All users and entities that can influence data serialization and deserialization.
policy_description: The product must validate data during deserialization to prevent vulnerabilities from untrusted data.
reference: CWE-ID: 502 | Name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

definition: Improper Access Control: The product does not restrict or incorrectly restricts access to a resource from an unauthorized actor.
scope: All users and entities accessing resources.
policy_description: The product must enforce proper access control mechanisms to prevent unauthorized access to resources.

definition: Missing Authentication for Critical Function: The product does not perform any authentication for functionality that requires a provable user identity.
scope: All users and entities accessing critical functions.
policy_description: The product must require authentication for all critical functions to ensure user identity is verified.
reference: CWE-ID: 306 | Name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

definition: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF): The web application does not sufficiently verify whether a request was intentionally provided by the user.
scope: All users and entities interacting with web applications.
policy_description: The product must implement measures to verify user intent for requests to prevent CSRF vulnerabilities.

definition: Exposure of Sensitive Information: The product exposes sensitive information to an actor that is not explicitly authorized.
scope: All users and entities accessing sensitive information.
policy_description: The product must ensure that sensitive information is not exposed to unauthorized actors.
reference: CWE-ID: 200 | Name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

definition: Authorization Bypass: The system's authorization functionality does not prevent one user from gaining access to another user's data.
scope: All users and entities accessing user data.
policy_description: The product must enforce strict authorization checks to prevent unauthorized access to user data.
reference: CWE-ID: 639 | Name: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

definition: Allocation of Resources Without Limits: The product allocates resources without imposing intended restrictions.
scope: All users and entities interacting with resource allocation.
policy_description: The product must impose limits on resource allocation to prevent abuse and denial of service.
reference: CWE-ID: 770 | Name: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
